funnel_edges.definition: Share of new-user acquisition attributed to AI search; not signup conversion from AI-search impressions.
Company reports about 1% eventual upgrade from its badge loop. Do not multiply this by AI-search acquisition share: denominators differ.

operating_goals.definition: Non-founder paid customers with an accepted artifact; exclude synthetic, refunded and test events.
Second accepted use in a fully matured seven-day cohort.

Earned sales excluding tax and pass-throughs, less attributable refunds, payment/channel/FX/acquisition/compute/tool/fulfillment/support costs and valued owner time; exact currency and period. Collected cash is reported separately.

Accepted eligible task runs divided by all eligible task runs in the fixed evaluation cohort, including failed attempts; minimum 20 observations before goal credit. Repeated trials are identified separately.
All customer-support minutes divided by active workspace-month equivalents for the complete matching period; exclude separately sold delivery time.

curation_runs.notes: 15 successful unique market-source scrapes at one reported credit each and three searches at two reported credits each. Cash cost unknown. These are retrieval receipts, not commercial outcomes. No provider-verified sales or public projection. Timestamp records seed compilation, not elapsed research duration.
